abstract: The invention relates to a transformer substation inspection robot, the transformer substation inspection robot comprises a four-footed bionic unit, a fire extinguishing unit and a control unit, the four-footed bionic unit comprises a body and mechanical legs arranged on the body; the fire extinguishing unit comprises a fire extinguishing module, a monitoring module and a first acquisition module, the monitoring module and the first acquisition module are arranged on the fire extinguishing module, the fire extinguishing module is rotatably arranged on the body, the monitoring module is used for monitoring fire signals of the transformer substation, and the first acquisition module is used for acquiring fire position information; and the control unit is in communication connection with the mechanical legs, the monitoring module, the first acquisition module and the fire extinguishing module, and is used for controlling the mechanical legs to cruise according to a preset path, controlling the first acquisition module to acquire fire position information according to the fire signal and controlling the fire extinguishing module to rotate to a fire position to extinguish fire according to the fire position information. Through the arrangement, the inspection robot can automatically extinguish fire in time when discovering a fire.
source_title: Transformer substation inspection robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of quadruped robots, and relates to a quadruped robot and a control system thereof. Comprising a body structure, and a head structure and a leg structure which are arranged on the body structure. Knowledge of numerous subjects such as computers, bionics, biomechanics and materials science is integrated on appearance construction, a conventional wheel type structure based on the SLAM algorithm is broken through, and the non-rotating wheel type robot with the moving speed capable of being matched with the data acquisition speed of the SLAM algorithm is designed. Innovation and breakthrough are made in the field of combination of the SLAM technology and the indoor foot type mobile robot. Dynamic target following can be achieved based on the SLAM positioning technology, the technologies of sound source positioning, voice navigation, voice remote control and the like of the intelligent robot are achieved in combination with a six-microphone array voice module and an offline voice recognition engine, and the experience level of man-machine voice intelligent interaction is further expanded.
source_title: Quadruped robot and control system thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a quadruped robot with functional instruments capable of being quickly disassembled and assembled, the quadruped robot comprises a shell part, the bottom of the shell part is connected with a trunk body and a matching assembly, and the matching assembly is used for quickly connecting the functional instruments; the button assembly is used for matching and clamping the matching assembly; the matching assembly comprises a cover turning piece and a sealing piece, and the sealing piece retracts to automatically open the cover turning piece. According to the quadruped robot with the functional instruments capable of being rapidly disassembled and assembled, through the arranged turning cover part, the turning cover plate can be directly opened for matched installation and connection in the installation and matching process of some functional instruments, the whole shell part does not need to be disassembled, the overall installation and matching efficiency is improved, meanwhile, overall installation and matching are more convenient, and the practicability is high. An operator can directly match with a chip of an internal trunk body of the quadruped robot according to the internal space exposed by the opened flip cover.
source_title: Quadruped robot with functional instruments capable of being rapidly disassembled and assembled

abstract: The invention discloses a hexapod robot which comprises a middle connecting part and six mechanical feet connected with the middle connecting part. Each mechanical foot comprises a first leg part connected with the middle connecting part, each first leg part is connected with a second leg part through a first joint part, each second leg part is connected with a third leg part through a second joint part, and each third leg part makes contact with the ground. Each first leg part comprises a first shell, and a first drive hole and a second drive hole are formed in the left side and the right side of the end, connected with the corresponding first joint part, of each first shell. Each first shell is internally provided with a first drive shaft, each first drive shaft is connected with a first drive mechanism through a first drive hole, and each first drive mechanism is in driving connection with the corresponding first joint part. Each first shell is internally provided with a second drive shaft, each second drive shaft is connected with a second drive mechanism through a second drive hole, and each second drive mechanism is in driving connection with the corresponding first joint part. By the adoption of the hexapod robot, the first joint parts can be driven to move in the same direction or in the different directions, so that the hexapod robot is better controlled to walk.
source_title: Hexapod robot

abstract: The electro-hydraulic hybrid quadruped robot is characterized in that the electro-hydraulic hybrid quadruped robot comprises hydraulic legs, front-back swing motors, hydraulic pumps, side unfolding hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic valves, batteries, machine body hydraulic cylinders, node boxes, a whole machine master controller, a gyroscope, a radiator, a machine frame and machine body hinge mechanisms; a power source of the robot is supplied with energy through a battery, a joint actuator comprises a hydraulic actuator and a motor actuator, two joint freedom degrees of the waist of the robot are added on the bionic design, and the robot is configured with 14 freedom degrees in total. The four-degree-of-freedom electric drive robot inherits the advantages of hydraulic drive and has the advantages of low noise, high reliability and convenience in maintenance and repair of an electric drive system, and high-speed maneuvering motion control of the robot is facilitated due to the arrangement of 14 degrees of freedom of the whole robot.
source_title: Electro-hydraulic hybrid quadruped robot integrated with bionic trunk

abstract: The invention discloses a three-femur leg structure and a quadruped robot, and relates to the technical field of quadruped robots. The three-femur leg structure comprises a lateral swing joint module,a hip joint module and a knee joint module. An output shaft of a lateral swing motor in the lateral swing joint module is fixedly connected with a lateral swing shaft. One end of a first hip joint connecting piece in the hip joint module is fixedly connected with the lateral swing shaft, and the other end of the first hip joint connecting piece in the hip joint module is fixed to a hip joint motor. The hip joint motor is installed between a second hip joint connecting piece and a third hip joint connecting piece. The knee joint module is fixed on the hip joint module. The knee joint motor isfixed in a thigh shell, and meshes with a first driven bevel gear fixed to a shank assembly through a driving bevel gear. The two ends of a knee joint shaft penetrate through the shank assembly and form rotational connection around the axis of the knee joint shaft on the thigh shell. According to the three-femur leg structure and the quadruped robot, the basic movement is ensured, the space volumeof a leg structure is fully reduced, the mechanical structure is compact, and the space layout is reasonable.
source_title: Three-femur leg structure and quadruped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a robot. The robot comprises a trunk; the walking legs are movably connected with the trunk; the driving assembly at least comprises a first driving piece capable of driving the walking leg to rotate around the first axis; the first driving part is provided with a first cable, the first cable comprises a winding section and a wire outlet section which are arranged in sequence, the winding section is wound between the trunk and the walking legs, and the wire outlet section extends towards the trunk from the winding section; and the fixing assembly is connected to the driving assembly, the fixing assembly comprises a fixing part, and the fixing part is configured to fix the wire outlet section. According to the invention, the first cable is wound between the trunk and the walking legs, so that the effects of accommodating and cooperating with the movement of the first driving piece are achieved; meanwhile, the fixing assembly is arranged in a matched mode to connect the first cable with the driving piece, fixing and storage of the first cable are achieved, the situation that the first cable is damaged due to interference of the external environment or the internal structure in the using process is avoided, and the reliability and safety of electric connection of the robot dog are improved.
source_title: Robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a cross quadruped robot. The cross quadruped robot comprises a square top plate, a square control panel, U-shaped connecting pieces, steering engines and foot plates, wherein the U-shaped connecting pieces include a first U-shaped connecting piece, a second U-shaped connecting piece, a third U-shaped connecting piece and a fourth U-shaped connecting piece, the steering engines include first steering engines, a second steering engine and a third steering engine, four first steering engines are installed between the square top plate and the square control panel, four corners of the inner side face of the square top plate are movably connected with one end of each of the four corresponding first steering engines through motor gaskets, and one end of each of the four first steering engines is movably connected with four corners of the inner side face of the square control panel through motor gaskets. The cross quadruped robot has the advantages that the cross quadruped robot can enter a dangerous environment to replace human and complete work high in danger coefficient and can be used for rescue in lots of accident and disaster sites.
source_title: Cross quadruped robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle bases, and particularly relates to an integrated flattened unmanned aerial vehicle base which comprises a quadruped robot body, fixing blocks are fixed to the four corners of the upper surface of the quadruped robot body, fixing plates are fixed to the upper surfaces of the fixing blocks, and remaining grooves are formed in the middles of the upper surfaces of the fixing plates. The fixing plate is provided with an indwelling groove, the indwelling groove penetrates through the corresponding positions on the surfaces of the two ends of the fixing plate, the two ends, located in the indwelling groove, of the fixing plate are each slidably provided with a moving plate in the horizontal direction, and the sides, away from each other, of the moving plates are each rotatably provided with a second rotating block. Therefore, the number of unmanned aerial vehicles needing to be stored in the unmanned aerial vehicle seat can be adjusted, the application range of the unmanned aerial vehicle seat in use can be guaranteed, and the unmanned aerial vehicle seat can be used conveniently.
source_title: Integrated unfoldable unmanned aerial vehicle seat

abstract: The invention discloses a tensioning integral quadruped robot which solves the problem that in the prior art, the flexibility of a robot is low, and has the beneficial effect of improving the flexibility and safety of the robot. According to the specific scheme, the tensioning integral quadruped robot comprises a spine structure and limb structures, and the limb structures are arranged at the two ends of the spine structure; the spine structure comprises multiple sets of spine units connected in sequence, each spine unit comprises multiple spine rod pieces, the multiple spine rod pieces of each spine unit are arranged in a conical mode, and every two adjacent spine units are connected through a flexible piece in a tensioning mode; each limb structure comprises a plurality of limb rod pieces arranged at set intervals, and every two adjacent limb rod pieces are connected through a second flexible piece in a tensioning mode; and the spine units located at the ends in the spine structure are connected with the limb rod pieces through third flexible pieces in a tensioning mode.
source_title: Tensioning integral quadruped robot

abstract: A position and posture compensation reconfigurable connecting rod device is composed of a reconfigurable connecting rod (A) and a position and posture compensation assembly (B), when the reconfigurable connecting rod (A) rolls transversely, the position and posture compensation assembly (B) compensates a roll angle, a connected execution unit can be kept still, and the position and posture compensation reconfigurable connecting rod device is applied to a multi-legged bionic robot with a reconfigurable trunk. And the roll angle generated by the reconfigurable rod piece in the robot trunk deformation process is compensated, stable supporting of the walking mechanism is guaranteed, and extra driving and control complexity is not increased.
source_title: Pose compensation reconfigurable connecting rod device

abstract: The invention discloses an explosion-proof area autonomous inspection method and system for a robot dog, and relates to the technical field of intelligent inspection of machines. The invention discloses an explosion-proof area autonomous inspection system for a robot dog. The explosion-proof area autonomous inspection system comprises a map building and sorting module, a global path planning module, a global path smoothing module, a local path optimization module and a state detection and alarm module. According to the method, the optimal inspection path planning of the two-dimensional space is carried out between the two adjacent starting points or inspection points through the improved A * algorithm, the inspection path can be dynamically adjusted according to the width of the channel, namely, a wider channel is preferentially selected to effectively reduce the collision risk, and it is ensured that the robot dog keeps a safe distance from the channel wall in the narrow channel; therefore, the safety and reliability of robot dog inspection are improved, the passing ability and inspection efficiency of an inspection path can be improved in combination with the kinematic characteristics of the robot dog, unnecessary detour is reduced, and the safety of the autonomous inspection method and system for the anti-explosion area of the robot dog is improved.
source_title: Explosion-proof area autonomous inspection method and system for robot dog

abstract: The invention discloses an air suction type fan tower climbing robot dog, and relates to the technical field of wind power generation high-place operation equipment. The robot comprises a robot body frame, four legs and a driving device, each leg comprises a thigh, a shank and a foot which are sequentially connected, the robot body frame is connected with each thigh, the driving device is arranged on the robot body frame, the driving device is connected with each leg, the robot further comprises a controller, a vacuum pump and a control pipeline, the controller and the vacuum pump are arranged on the robot body frame, and the vacuum pump is arranged on the robot body frame. The feet are suckers, the control pipeline comprises a pipeline and an electromagnetic valve arranged on the pipeline, one end of the pipeline is connected and communicated with the vacuum pump, the other end of the pipeline is connected and communicated with the suckers, and the controller is electrically connected with the driving device and the electromagnetic valve. Through the controller, the vacuum pump, the control pipeline, the suction cup and the like, the robot dog can climb the tower of the wind generating set.
source_title: Air suction type fan tower climbing robot dog

abstract: The bionic quadruped robot comprises a robot head structure, a robot belly structure, a robot tail structure and a neck steering structure, the robot head structure is connected with the robot belly structure through the neck steering structure, one end of the robot belly structure is connected with the robot tail structure, and the other end of the robot belly structure is connected with the robot tail structure. Leg structures are connected to four corners of the robot abdomen structure; the joint is simple and compact in structure, and flexible swinging of the joint and compression of the internal space of the robot are achieved; the neck part adopts a single-shaft two-degree-of-freedom structure, two steering engines are put down in a smaller space, the head shaking and nodding actions of the bionic cat are realized, the structure is novel, the movement is flexible, and the occupied space is small; and the tail part adopts a wire pulling mechanism, the reciprocating swing of each tail joint on one plane is realized by utilizing the rotation of a vertical coil, and the balance of the bionic cat during movement can be kept through the movement of the tail part structure.
source_title: Bionic quadruped robot with single-axis two-degree-of-freedom structure

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and discloses a wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot. The wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot comprises a transformablewheel leg mechanism, a driving control unit and multiple functional module units, wherein the transformable wheel leg mechanism is used for realizing a gait driving function and a wheel type driving function; the driving control unit and the multiple functional module units are arranged in the transformable wheel leg mechanism; the transformable wheel leg mechanism comprises a serial mechanism which is formed by connecting a first supporting leg, a second supporting leg and a third supporting leg with different structures through corresponding rotating shafts and has three rotation freedom degrees; and the external edges of the first supporting leg, the second supporting leg and the third supporting leg are of circular arc structures with same diameters. According to the wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot, the integral structure is simple; the rigidity is high; the stability is reliable; the wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot takes both obstacle crossing ability and moving speed into considerations; multiple functional modules can be additionally arranged so that the wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot has complete functions; and very high practicability and broad application value are realized.
source_title: Wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention discloses a wireless control pneumatic bionic creeping robot dog, mainly comprising brackets and a connector; each of the brackets includes left and right structures which are completely the same to each other; the bracket adopts a doubling plate framework structure; an electromagnetic exchange valve is mounted between two layers of plates; peripheries of the two plates are vertically connected by a link rod; two brackets are moveably connected through the connector; the same side of the upper plate of each of the brackets is equipped with a steering unit; the bottom part of the lower plate of the bracket is fixedly equipped with a thigh cylinder A and a thigh cylinder B in parallel, the moving end of the thigh cylinder A is connected with a shank cylinder A; the shank cylinder A and the thigh cylinder A are in a vertical state; the bottom part of the shank cylinder A is vertically and fixedly connected with a sole A; the moving end of the thigh cylinder B is connected with the shank cylinder B, and the shank cylinder B is perpendicular to the thigh cylinder; the bottom part of the shank cylinder B is vertically and fixedly connected with a sole B. The wireless control pneumatic bionic creeping robot dog is simple in structure, high in utilization rate, and convenient to steer, and so on.
source_title: Wireless control pneumatic bionic creeping robot dog

abstract: The invention provides a line-driven quadruped soft robot which comprises a robot body, a driving module, a walking module and a control module, the robot body is a cross-shaped support, the driving module comprises a driving motor and a driving line, and the driving motor is arranged on the cross-shaped support; the walking module is a flexible soft leg, the flexible soft leg is arranged on the cross-shaped support, and the flexible soft leg is connected with the driving motor through the driving wire; the control module is arranged on the cross-shaped support, the control module is electrically connected with the driving motors, according to the line-driven four-legged soft robot, the driving motors are used for controlling the driving lines, the driving lines drive the flexible soft legs to swing, and therefore continuous, rapid and large-amplitude turning is achieved through a simple structure; and the working efficiency of the soft robot is effectively improved.
source_title: Line-driven quadruped soft robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear power robots, and particularly relates to a multi-mode quadruped robot special for a 5G nuclear power station and having the capacity of a large model. Comprising a control module, a power module, a mechanical arm module, a power module, a sensor module, a radiator, an audio module and a shell structure, and the control module, the power module, the mechanical arm module, the power module, the sensor module, the radiator and the audio module are installed on the shell structure. The quadruped robot has the beneficial effects that through integration of various advanced security functions, compared with a traditional artificial security system, the quadruped robot special for the nuclear power station shows remarkable advantages and beneficial effects in multiple aspects, the safety is improved, the response speed is increased, the quadruped robot can uninterruptedly patrol for 24 hours, and the service life of the quadruped robot is prolonged. And compared with manual patrol, the safety monitoring efficiency and the emergency response speed of the nuclear power station are greatly improved.
source_title: Special 5G nuclear power station quadruped robot with multi-mode and large model capacity

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a slidable quadruped robot which comprises a front robot body, a rear robot body and four legs distributed on the two sides of the front robot body and the two sides of the rear robot body, and is characterized in that the front robot body and the rear robot body are rotationally connected through a waist joint; the upper end of the pelvic bone is rotationally connected with the front machine body and the rear machine body, the joint is a rolling hip joint, the upper end of the thigh is rotationally connected with the lower end of the pelvic bone, the joint is a pitching hip joint, the upper end of the shank is rotationally connected with the lower end of the thigh, and the joint is a knee joint. The first follower wheel is rotationally arranged on the side face of the upper end of the shank, the second follower wheel is rotationally arranged on the side face of the lower end of the shank, and the foot end is fixedly arranged at the tail end of the lower end of the shank. Under the condition that leg type movement of the robot is not affected, the sliding gait of the robot is achieved, and the movement efficiency of the robot on the flat ground, especially in slope downward movement is improved.
source_title: Slidable quadruped robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic robots, in particular to a multi-legged bionic robot which comprises a plurality of bearing supports, a plurality of posture adjusting modules, a plurality of pairs of displacement modules, a controller and a communicator. The plurality of bearing brackets are sequentially arranged from front to back, and in any two adjacent bearing brackets, the tail end of one bearing bracket is rotationally connected with the head end of the other bearing bracket; the posture adjusting modules are arranged on the bearing supports and used for adjusting the overturning postures of the bearing supports. The multiple pairs of displacement modules are arranged on the multiple bearing supports correspondingly and used for driving the bearing supports to move. The controller is arranged on one bearing support and electrically connected with the multiple posture adjusting modules and the multiple pairs of displacement modules. The communicator is arranged on one bearing support, electrically connected with the controller and in wireless communication with the control device. According to the invention, the defect of poor obstacle avoidance flexibility in the prior art is overcome, and the method has the characteristic of high practicability.
source_title: Multi-legged bionic robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot steering track planning method and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of robot control. After the expected steering angle of the spider type quadruped robot in the floating base coordinate system in the current gait period is obtained, the expected supporting foot displacement of the spider type quadruped robot in the floating base coordinate system matched with the posture of the robot body in the current gait period is calculated according to the expected steering angle; discrete trajectory planning is carried out in the floating base coordinate system according to the obtained expected supporting foot displacement, so that an appropriate expected supporting foot steering motion trajectory is planned in the floating base coordinate system matched with the posture of the robot body in real time according to steering requirements in the movement process of the spider type quadruped robot; according to the planed supporting foot steering motion track, it is ensured that the smooth and rapid body steering motion effect is achieved while the body posture of the corresponding spider type quadruped robot is maintained to be stable.
source_title: Robot steering track planning method and related equipment

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of nondestructive detection and maintenance of heat transfer tubes of steam generators, and particularly relates to a multi-legged robot for repairing theheat transfer tubes. The robot comprises a body, bionic legs, fixing devices, a probe guide device and a drive module, wherein the plurality of bionic legs are arranged on the body, the fixing devicesare arranged at the tail ends of the bionic legs, the probe guiding device is arranged on the body, and a probe or a maintenance tool is arranged at the tail end of the probe guide device; the drivemodule drives the bionic legs, so that the fixing devices extend into the heat transfer tubes and expand inside the heat transfer tubes, and the body is hung upside down below a tube plate of the steam generator; the drive module drives the probe guide device to change position, so that the probe or the maintenance tool arranged at the tail end of the probe guide device is positioned directly below the tube orifice of to-be-repaired heat transfer tubes to carry out relevant maintenance work. According to the robot, by controlling the freedom degree of each bionic leg and the sliding movement of the probe guide device, the hole position of a positioning pipe of to-be-repaired targets of the robot can be changed, so that the function of repairing multiple heat transfer tubes through positioning by once are realized.
source_title: Multi-legged robot for repairing heat transfer tubes

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a motion control method and device for a multi-legged robot, and the method comprises the steps: controlling the multi-legged robot to be switched to a preset control mode under the condition that the stress of the multi-legged robot changes. Through the method and the device, the problem that the motor idles and is out of control when the multi-legged robot is suspended in the prior art is solved, and the effects that leg movement of the multi-legged robot is effectively controlled, the intelligent degree of the robot is improved, and damage to the robot is reduced are achieved.
source_title: Motion control method and device for multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention relates to a method for controlling a robot and a flexible screen interaction quadruped robot. A flexible screen fitting the shape of the robot is arranged on the body surface of the robot. The method for controlling the robot comprises the following steps: a dialogue window is displayed through the flexible screen, and the display position of the dialogue window is matched with the observation angle of a user; and the calling mode of the dialogue window can be any one of the following two modes: mode 1, a user can call the dialogue window by touching any position on the flexible screen, and the dialogue window is unfolded by taking the position clicked by the user as a center; and mode 2, the user calls the robot through voice, and the voice of the user is directed according to a microphone array carried on the robot, so that the dialogue window is displayed towards the direction of the user. According to the invention, the flexible screen is installed on the robot body, and the scheme of multi-sensor information fusion of vision, hearing, touch and the like is adopted; and therefore, the effect that the display dialogue window on the quadruped robot body can dynamically move along with the observation and use angle of the user is achieved, and the use experience of the user is improved.
source_title: Method for controlling robot and flexible screen interaction quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot landing foot force distribution method. The quadruped robot landing foot force distribution method comprises the steps that a virtual model of a machine bodyand an impedance model of each foot end are established in a same cartesian coordinate system; a stiffness mapping relationship between the virtual model and the impedance models is determined based on a force/torque balance relationship; a friction cone constraint and an internal force balance constraint are introduced to determine a linear relationship between X/Y/Z axial components of the landing foot force; fictitious force-fictitious torque of the machine body is determined according to a deviation value between a current pose and a desired pose in the cartesian coordinate system; and based on the Newton-euler equation, according to the stiffness mapping relationship, the linear relationship between the X/Y/Z axial components of the landing foot force and the virtual force-virtual torque of the machine body, the X/Y/Z axial components of the landing foot force of supporting foots are calculated. The quadruped robot landing foot force distribution method can realize the fast solution calculation of the analytical solution of the landing foot force, and has the advantages of high calculation efficiency and a low hardware cost.
source_title: Quadruped robot landing foot force distribution method and device, terminal and computer readable storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to an omni-directional moving foot type robot leg structure and a quadruped robot, the omni-directional moving foot type robot leg structure comprises a supporting plate, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, and the thigh assembly comprises a first driving source, a second driving source and a thigh shaft; a driving bevel gear is arranged at the output end of the first driving source, a rotating frame is arranged at the output end of the second driving source, a driven bevel gear is arranged on the rotating frame, the driven bevel gear is meshed with the driving bevel gear, and the driven bevel gear is perpendicular to the driving bevel gear; the shank assembly comprises a third driving source, a fourth driving source, a first driving rod, a second driving rod, a first shank and a second shank; the thigh assembly and the shank assembly have two rotational degrees of freedom and are independently controlled by the two thigh motors and the two shank motors respectively. Omni-directional movement of the foot mechanism can be achieved by connecting the thigh assembly and the shank assembly in series. Compared with a traditional three-degree-of-freedom leg structure, the mechanism has a larger foot end working space and a simpler control mode.
source_title: Leg structure of omni-directional moving foot type robot and quadruped robot

abstract: A six-legged walking robot according to the present invention comprises a body part which includes two motors; and left and right leg parts which are formed on both surfaces of the body part and driven by the motors. Each of the left and right leg parts is formed in a link body structure which is the same as each other and is composed of a front leg, a middle leg, and a rear leg, wherein the middle leg is formed in a four-bar link body structure and is connected to the front and rear legs through additional connection links to transfer driving force from the motors to the front and rear legs.
source_title: SIX-LEGGED WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a motion control system for a quadruped robot. The motion control system comprises an instruction receiving and processing module, an action management module, a motion control function module, a data interaction module, an analog simulation module and a real machine execution module. According to the quadruped robot motion control system provided by the invention, independent development of each module is realized; motion control instructions can be sent through various control modes such as hardware access/network access, robot state data can be monitored in real time, problem analysis can be carried out, the system architecture is clear, the module coupling degree is low, the system robustness is good, an algorithm is independently packaged into a module, the control algorithm can be directly verified under the condition that other software logic is not changed, and the control efficiency is improved. The method is suitable for function development, simulation and debugging of various robots based on embedded equipment, and the application range is wide.
source_title: Motion control system of quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a fire-fighting robot for converting a walking mode. The robot includes a shear fork type lifting platform, a four-legged hinge linkage mechanism with a four-legged walking mode, and a crawler wheel mechanism with a crawler walking mode. The shear fork type lifting platform includes a driving device, a four-legged bottom plate and a lower bottom plate; the four-legged hingelinkage mechanism is installed on the four-legged bottom plate; the crawler wheel mechanism is installed on the lower bottom plate; the lower bottom plate is slidably connected with the four-legged bottom plate; the lower bottom plate is connected with the driving device; the driving device drives the lower bottom plate to rise or descend, when the lower bottom plate descends, then the crawler wheel mechanism walks on the ground; and when the lower bottom plate rises, the crawler wheel mechanism is lifted up, and the four-legged hinge link mechanism walks on the ground. A conversion process of the robot is fast and safe, the robot is strong in practicability, and a four-legged walking mode enables the robot to rapidly walk on a relatively flat road; and a crawler walking mode enables therobot to walk like on a flat ground in a relatively harsh environment, and the off-road performance of a crawler is fully displayed.
source_title: Fire-fighting robot for converting walking mode

abstract: The invention discloses a remote control solid phase microextraction sampling device and a sampling method. The remote control solid phase microextraction sampling device comprises a four-footed bionic robot and an intelligent sampling platform arranged at the top of the four-footed bionic robot, the intelligent sampling platform comprises a steering engine, a sampling telescopic device, an airtight injector and a dynamic needle trapping device, the sampling telescopic device is connected with the steering engine, and the airtight injector is connected with the steering engine. The airtight injector is connected with a telescopic rod of the sampling telescopic device, the dynamic needle trapping device is connected with the airtight injector, the dynamic needle trapping device comprises a needle tube and a needle tail, the end part of the needle tube is provided with a sample inlet, and the needle tube is filled with an adsorption material. The remote control solid-phase microextraction sampling device can replace sampling personnel to arrive at a dangerous site for exploration and sampling, has relatively strong capability of adapting to complex road conditions, can realize harmless zero-risk sample collection and rapid analysis and identification, and has wide and practical market application prospects.
source_title: Remote control solid phase microextraction sampling device and sampling method

abstract: The invention discloses an electric control shape memory alloy wire bionic quadruped robot which is mainly composed of a fixing plate, a connecting plate, a memory alloy wire, a spring, a thigh, a shank, a rubber foot and an electric control device. Four legs of the quadruped robot are fixed to a fixing plate, and each leg is composed of a connecting plate, two memory alloy wires, two springs, a thigh, a shank, a rubber foot and the like. The two metal wires of the legs are controlled to contract, and then the springs are compressed to complete the actions of stepping backwards and lifting upwards. And the springs sleeved outside the memory alloy wires enable the legs to rebound, so that the actions of stretching the legs forwards and putting the legs downwards are completed. Under the control of the electric control device, the four legs are matched with one another to achieve the gait of the quadruped animal, and the robot is driven to complete corresponding movement. And the robot is driven by the memory alloy wires, so that miniaturization of the robot can be realized, and the robot has great advantages in the aspect of narrow space detection. The method has advanced guiding significance and practical value for research and application of the memory alloy wire.
source_title: Bionic quadruped robot driven by electrically-controlled shape memory alloy wires

abstract: The invention discloses a vertebral body structure suitable for a multi-legged robot and the multi-legged robot, and belongs to the technical field of robotics.The vertebral body structure comprises a lumbar vertebra body composed of a plurality of vertebral body sections and flexible shaft assemblies on the two sides of the vertebral body sections, the vertebral body sections can be flexibly connected in series to form a string, and the vertebral body sections and the flexible shaft assemblies on the two sides are arranged in parallel; the robot comprises a head, a tail and lumbar vertebra main bodies, the head is connected with the front-end vertebra main body and one end of a flexible shaft assembly through an adjusting unit, the tail is connected with the rear-end vertebra main body and the other end of the flexible shaft assembly through a retracting and releasing unit, and the adjusting unit and the retracting and releasing unit drive the angle change of the adjacent vertebra main bodies through the flexible shaft assembly to simulate lumbar vertebra deformation. The structure is small, exquisite and compact, and multi-section controllable bending and free bending in two directions are achieved through the control system; meanwhile, processing is convenient, and manufacturing cost is low; load bearing is improved by means of the multiple vertebral bodies, flexible connection of the flexible shaft assemblies and the vertebral bodies has extremely high elastic recovery performance, and adaptability of the robot is improved.
source_title: Vertebral body structure suitable for multi-legged robot and multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of quadruped robots, and discloses a fire fighting quadruped robot with self-adaptive temperature adjustment and heat insulation, which comprises a robot body and robot feet in shaft connection with the outer wall of the robot body, the upper end of the robot body is provided with a water source pressurization main body, and the input end of the water source pressurization main body is connected with a communicating pipeline; a pressure regulating valve is installed at the upper end of the water source pressurizing body, a water spraying pipe assembly is movably installed at the end, away from the communicating pipeline, of the water source pressurizing body, a temperature regulating control terminal is installed on the outer wall of one side of the robot body, and when an electric push rod A and an electric push rod B synchronously operate, a water spraying straight pipe and a movable bent pipe are separated to form a controllable gap; a pressurized water source leaks through a gap to form self-spraying water flow, the robot body is cooled, water flow which is only used for fire extinguishing originally is ingeniously converted into a cooling medium, and the problems that response lag is caused by a traditional independent cooling system, and task execution efficiency and reliability are affected are solved.
source_title: Fire extinguishing quadruped robot with self-adaptive temperature adjustment and heat insulation functions

abstract: The invention provides a control method for diagonal trotting gaits of a quadruped robot facing opposite legs. The control method comprises the specific steps that initialization is conducted, and data received by a sensor and data received by a camera are transmitted to a main control board; the method comprises the following steps of: dividing actions of a single leg of the quadruped robot into four stages according to a diagonal trotting gait and structural characteristics; a left front leg and a right front leg are defined as forward legs, a left rear leg and a right rear leg are defined as reverse legs, coordinates of a relative coordinate system of foot ends in all the legs in the quadruped robot are generated through posture judgment of the diagonal trotting gait in all stages, the angle of a rotating shaft in all the legs in the quadruped robot is calculated, and control over the diagonal trotting gait is completed; and the left front leg and the right rear leg of the quadruped robot finish the diagonal small running gait under the control signal according to the actions of the front legs and the rear legs. The gravity center of the robot body is kept at the central position all the time by changing the actions of the legs of the quadruped robot at high frequency, and the balance of the robot body is high.
source_title: Method for controlling diagonal trotting gait of quadruped robot facing opposite legs

abstract: The invention provides a robot bionic foot and a robot with the same. The bionic foot comprises a base plate, a claw assembly, a first supporting foot, a first elastic assembly, a calcaneus supportingpiece, a second guide rod, a second supporting foot, a second elastic assembly, a first rotating piece, a second rotating piece and a third rotating piece. The claw assembly comprises a first guide rod, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a claw and a supporting rod. The first guide rod is movably arranged on the base plate; one end of the first connecting rod is fixedly connected with one end of the first guide rod; the other end of the first connecting rod is rotatably connected with one end of the second connecting rod, the claw is rotatably connected with the second connecting rod and the supporting rod, the first elastic assembly is located between the base plate and the first supporting foot, the second guide rod is movably arranged on the calcaneus supporting piece, and the second elastic assembly is located between the base plate and the second supporting foot. By means of the technical scheme, the technical problems that in the prior art, a quadruped robot is poor in rapid and stable movement capacity and prone to slipping are solved.
source_title: Robot bionic foot and robot with same

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot climbing gait, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The gait takes a static stability criterion as a theoretical basis. When the robot climbs a slope, the robot body is kept parallel to the slope surface, at most one leg of the robot is in a swing phase at any moment, and before one leg of the robot enters the swing phase, the robot body moves tothe limit position in the direction opposite to the leg so that the static stability margin of the robot is guaranteed to the maximum extent. According to the method, the stability margin of the quadruped robot during climbing can be greatly increased, the climbing performance of the quadruped robot is improved, the gait is simple and good universality and practicability are achieved.
source_title: Quadruped robot climbing gait

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-legged robot load balancing method and device and a multi-legged robot. The method comprises the steps that the current position and speed of goods on a trunk are obtained through a force sensor arranged on the trunk; according to the current position and speed of the goods, an expected posture required by the trunk when the goods reaches balance is solved through a feedback control law; according to the expected posture of the trunk, the expected position of a virtual joint is determined, and according to the expected position, the joint torque needed by a real joint is calculated based on a full-dynamics control algorithm of the robot; and the calculated joint torque is sent to the corresponding real joint, so that the trunk reaches the expected posture. According to the method, the aim that the multi-legged robot actively balances the goods can be fundamentally achieved, in the goods transportation process, the goods do not need to be specially fixed, balance control can be carried out only by placing the goods near the expected position, and balance of the goods can be guaranteed even in the rapid walking process.
source_title: Multi-legged robot load balancing method and device and multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of quadruped robot control, and provides a quadruped robot action design and complex behavior generation method and system, and the method comprises the steps: building an animation model of a quadruped robot according to the information of the quadruped robot; performing action design according to the animation model; track data extraction is carried out on the designed actions, optimization is carried out by taking the maximum accumulated reward obtained by the quadruped robot as a target, and an action library is established; combining the actions in the action library under a time axis to generate behavior track data; and controlling the quadruped robot according to the generated behavior track data. On the basis of a visual animation model, action design is carried out in an action function mode, actions are more flexible and editable, the actions can be changed by easily modifying the function, and the action design efficiency is improved on the premise that accurate action control is achieved; meanwhile, the behaviors are combined and generated under the time axis, the time combination process is short, and the behavior generation efficiency is high.
source_title: Quadruped robot action design and complex behavior generation method and system

abstract: The invention provides a quadruped robot and a spine-leg-foot coupling driving method, and relates to the technical field of biomimetic robots, the quadruped robot comprises an active spine and two limbs, the two limbs are a front limb and a rear limb, and the two limbs can pitch and are telescopically arranged at the two ends of the active spine in the front-back direction; the active spine can drive the limbs to pitch and stretch out and draw back. According to the spine-leg-foot coupling driving method, the pitching and contraction states of the spine and the energy storage and release states of the legs during running of the quadruped animal are simulated by coupling and controlling the swing state of the swing output piece, the stretching and contraction states of the limbs and the energy storage and release states of the elastic legs. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the running posture of the quadruped animal can be simulated more truly, so that the moving speed and the energy efficiency are improved.
source_title: Quadruped robot and spine-leg-foot coupling driving method

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a lightweight full-elbow type quadruped robot which comprises a rack, a heat dissipation mechanism, a plurality of supporting leg assemblies and a plurality of flow guide shells, each supporting leg assembly comprises a connecting part, a driving part and a supporting leg, the connecting parts are installed on the rack, a containing cavity is formed in each connecting part, the driving parts are installed in the containing cavities, and the supporting legs are arranged in the containing cavities; the supporting legs are in transmission connection with the driving part which is used for driving the supporting legs to move. The flow guide shell is installed on the connecting part and communicates with the containing cavity, a ventilation opening is formed in the flow guide shell, and an adjusting assembly used for adjusting an opening of the ventilation opening is installed in the flow guide shell; and the heat dissipation mechanism is mounted on the rack, is connected with the air vents of the flow guide shells, and is used for discharging heat of the driving part through the corresponding accommodating cavities and the flow guide shells. The driving parts can be cooled at the same time, the cooling degree of the single driving part can be adjusted, and the situation that the aging degrees of the driving parts of the supporting leg assemblies are different, and consequently the motion control precision of the legs is affected is avoided.
source_title: Lightweight full-elbow quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a hexapod robot. The hexapod robot comprises a middle connection part and six mechanical feet connected with the middle connection part; the mechanical feet comprise first leg parts connected with the middle connection part, the first leg parts are connected with second leg parts through first joint parts, the second leg parts are connected with third leg parts through second joint parts, and the third leg parts make contact with the ground; each first joint part comprises a first adaptor and a second adaptor; each first adaptor comprises a middle supporting plate, the two ends of each middle supporting plate extend outwards and form clamping arms correspondingly, and the clamping arms are perpendicular to the middle supporting plates; each first leg part is internally provided with a first driving shaft and a second driving shaft; each first driving shaft is connected with the one of every two clamping arms through a first driving mechanism, and each second driving shaft is connected with the other clamping arm through a second driving mechanism; and the first adaptors and the second adaptors are perpendicularly connected. Movement of the mechanical feet is convenient to control, the control direction is convenient to change, operation is simplified, and control and walking of the hexapod robot are convenient.
source_title: Hexapod robot

abstract: The invention relates to a foot end structure of a foot type robot, a leg movement mechanism and a quadruped robot; the foot end structure comprises a wheel type assembly, and the wheel type assembly comprises a hollow rubber tire, a wheel column arranged in the center of the rubber tire and two external supporting rings; the two external supporting rings are coaxially arranged on the two sides of the wheel column respectively, the external supporting rings are rotationally connected with the wheel column, and a locking mechanism is arranged between each external supporting ring and the wheel column. The foot type robot can slide on the flat ground and can also walk in a locked mode, the problems that an existing foot-type robot walks slowly on the flat ground and is not like a wheel type robot in convenience, quickness and flexibility are solved, and the problem that an existing wheel type robot is prone to sliding and retreating when climbing a slope is also solved; the foot end structure is compact in structure and high in integration degree, forward and reverse rotation locking can be achieved, and braking with certain strength can also be achieved.
source_title: Foot end structure of foot type robot, leg movement mechanism and quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional multi-legged bionic robot system on the basis of pneumatic systems. Legs of a multi-legged robot can be driven by pneumatic muscles and air cylinders, and effects of freely switching complete working modes and increasing functions can be realized. Bionic lower limbs mainly comprise the legs, motors, the pneumatic muscles, the air cylinders and wheels. Thefour legs can be driven by the multiple air cylinders to drive the multi-legged robot to move in a coordinative manner, the multi-legged robot can be jointly driven by the legs formed by the multiplepneumatic muscles and the two rear legs driven by the air cylinders to normally cross obstacles and move forwardly when explosive handling and detection work and the like are required, the two front legs driven by the air cylinders can be driven by the motors, and the two front legs and the air cylinders can act with one another to be converted into arms with operation functions. The multifunctional multi-legged bionic robot system has the advantages that the multifunctional multi-legged bionic robot system can be driven by the motors, the air cylinders and the pneumatic muscles, is simple andcompact in structure, has diversified functions and can be used for obstacle crossing, explosive handling and detection tasks and the like, and the diversified work modes can be freely switched.
source_title: Multifunctional multi-legged bionic robot system on basis of pneumatic systems

abstract: The invention relates to a construction site dynamic inspection system based on man-machine-dog cooperation and an autonomous control method, and relates to the technical field of intelligent construction and robot cooperative control, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, multi-modal data collection and fusion: through a fixed collection device and a dynamic inspection device arranged at a construction site, carrying out multi-modal data collection and fusion; static information and dynamic information of a construction site are collected at the same time, the static information comprises environment data, and the dynamic information comprises motion trails of objects, personnel and equipment in the construction environment. A cooperative control mechanism among the ground quadruped robot, the aerial unmanned aerial vehicle and the wearable terminal is constructed, and a space partition and path network is generated in combination with a building information model, so that comprehensive coverage of a multi-layer space and a complex structure area on a construction site can be realized; the problem that high-altitude blind areas and sheltered areas are difficult to inspect in a traditional scheme is effectively solved, and the space integrity and environment adaptability of inspection tasks are improved.
source_title: Construction site dynamic inspection system based on man-machine-dog cooperation and autonomous control method

abstract: The present invention relates to a multi-legged walking apparatus which allows a multi-legged walking robot to make motions smoothly and to walk. The multi-legged walking apparatus includes: a front leg part including a body part including a body, a front leg fixing part fixed to the body, and a front rotation part rotatably connected to the front fixing part; a rear leg part including a rear fixing part fixed to the body and a rear rotation part rotatably connected to the rear fixing part; and a first link of which both ends are respectively connected to the front rotation part and the rear rotation part. The body part further includes a driving part for rotating one of the front and rear rotation parts. According to the present invention, the first link and the driving part may be provided to allow the main body to smoothly make a motion to the front and rear directions by matching the movement of the legs when the multi-legged walking robot walks. Thus, the multi-legged walking robot may exhibit a walking motion similar to that of an actual animal which walks using multiple legs.
source_title: MULTI-LEGGED WALKING APPARATUS

abstract: According to the ground contact detection method for the hydraulic quadruped robot based on the evidence theory, after three different data sources are adopted to obtain the joint torque characteristic values of the joints, the evidence theory is adopted to fuse the three joint torque characteristic values, and compared with independent use of a force sensor and independent use of a displacement sensor, the method has the advantages that the reliability is high; according to the method, data information of the force sensor and the displacement sensor is fused, the grounding detection accuracy is higher, the real-time performance is better, the robustness of grounding detection judgment can be greatly improved, and a good foundation is laid for gait planning and control of the hydraulic quadruped robot.
source_title: Hydraulic quadruped robot grounding detection method based on evidence theory

abstract: The invention provides a closed-chain quadruped robot with a stopping adjusting characteristic. The stability of supporting phases of leg ends of the robot and leg lifting heights of crossing phases of the leg ends of the robot are adjusted by using an intermittent mechanism so that the passing ability and transporting ability of the robot on complicated grounds are guaranteed, and the obstacle crossing ability is improved while the transporting smoothness is taken into account. The whole closed-chain quadruped robot with the stopping adjusting characteristic is provided with power by using two motors; the single leg is a single-degree-of-freedom mechanism; and therefore, the complexity of a control system is simplified, and the control reliability is effectively guaranteed. The closed-chain quadruped robot with the stopping adjusting characteristic can be used for places such as detection, investigation and material transportation, under a mountain environment.
source_title: Closed-chain quadruped robot with stopping adjusting characteristic

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aircraft maintenance robots, in particular to a multi-legged crawling robot control system and method, and the system controls a multi-legged crawling robot to move and monitors an image captured by a camera; the control method comprises switchable crawling gait control, obstacle crossing gait control and image monitoring control. The control system comprises a motion control subsystem and a video transmission subsystem, the motion control subsystem comprises a multi-legged crawling robot digital steering engine and a task manager which are in communication control, and the task manager receives a terminal command and controls the digital steering engine through a forward kinematics control module and a motion algorithm module. And the motion algorithm module is used for calculating and controlling the gait coordinates. According to the technical scheme, the mobile control modes can be flexibly switched, meanwhile, different detection modes are provided for corresponding targets, a double-camera mode is set, and the purposes of large-range rapid observation and accurate detection are achieved.
source_title: Multi-legged crawling robot control system and control method

abstract: The invention relates to a four-footed inspection robot early warning device applying vibration fault detection, and aims to solve the technical problem that vibration faults are easy to occur under the conditions of complex terrain, load change and long-term operation of mechanical parts due to poor vibration fault detection and early warning structural design of existing similar products. The device is characterized in that a body of the device is a quadruped robot, a depth camera is arranged at the head of one end of the quadruped robot, a horizontal rotating and angle adjusting machine is mounted on a mounting base plate at a machine body shell of the back of the quadruped robot, and the upper end of the horizontal rotating and angle adjusting machine is fixedly connected to a connecting plate of a shock absorber; the upper portion of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a shock absorber, the upper end of the shock absorber is fixedly connected with a portable laser vibration meter, the lower end of the portable laser vibration meter and the shock absorber on the rear side wall are each provided with a shock absorption mechanism, and the two shock absorption mechanisms are connected with the two ends of a shell of the portable laser vibration meter respectively. The horizontal rotating and angle adjusting mechanism is a two-degree-of-freedom holder.
source_title: Quadruped inspection robot early warning device applying vibration fault detection

abstract: A two-segment-type rolling quadruped robot comprises a trunk, four legs with the same structure, and an electric control part. The trunk is a rectangular box in the center of the body, and fixing holes are formed in the two sides of the trunk and used for being connected with the leg parts; the legs are divided into the large legs and the small legs; the large legs are the first segments of non-deformable parts connected with the trunk and are each constituted by two completely same U-shaped steering engine brackets which are crossed in a cross-shaped mode, and the two ends of the large legs are fixed to steering engines through screws, wherein the two U-shaped steering engine brackets are fixed through screws; the small legs are each constituted by two side plates which are approximate tosemicircles, wherein the two side plates are parallelly opposite and are fixed through supporting columns; the steering engines are mounted on the inner sides of the side plats; the electric controlpart comprises a single chip microcomputer, the steering engines, driving plates of the steering engines, and six-axis sensors; the steering engines serve as joints to connect the large legs with thesmall legs, and the steering engines on the trunk connect the large legs with the trunk; and the steering engines drive the large legs and the small legs to deflect, and thus the robot deforms to be in a cylindrical state. Movement of crawling and rolling can be completed, the terrain adaptation is good, and the structure is simple.
source_title: Two-segment-type rolling quadruped robot

abstract: A spider robot leg mechanism for game and work method are applicable to a bionic multi-legged spider robot used in antagonism game. The front end of the main leg of the spider robot is provided with apassive reaction mechanism which prevents the robot leg from being stuck in a rock gap when the robot leg falling to the ground; As that leg get stuck in a crack in the rock during traveling, the blocking force causes the slider spring in the elongated hole to raise follow the lifting of the mechanical leg, and moving to the left side of the elongated hole along the fixed sliding direction, At this time, that spring arranged on the left side of the slide block is in a compressed state, The spring arranged on the right side of the slider is in a tensile state, and the tip of the main leg shallcoincide with the rotational center of the end of the leg, that is, the position of the bolt. Because the lower side baffle of the leg is slightly lower, the leg is bent downward with the slider boltas the center, and the obstructive force of the rock acting on the leg is reduced by bending the leg to extricate itself from the trap. The spider robot leg mechanism has the advantages of simple structure and good use effect.
source_title: A spider robot leg mechanism for game and work method

abstract: The invention provides a deformable folding type hexapod robot which comprises a first advancing assembly and second advancing assemblies, and the second advancing assemblies are installed on the two sides of the first advancing assembly. The second marching leg, the fourth marching leg and the sixth marching leg are folded and combined to form a circle, and are driven by the first motor, so that the connecting plate drives the second marching leg, the fourth marching leg and the sixth marching leg to rotate, and leg type movement of the hexapod robot is converted into wheel type movement; a higher traveling speed is obtained on a flat road surface, the traveling efficiency is improved, a second traveling leg, a fourth traveling leg and a sixth traveling leg are unfolded and are used for leg type movement, the robot can better adapt to a rugged road surface, and the robot can move on the rugged road surface through mutual conversion of leg type movement and wheel type movement. The adaptive capacity of the bionic robot to the road surface is improved, and the application range of the robot is widened.
source_title: Deformable folding type hexapod robot

abstract: The invention discloses a water and rain condition emergency monitoring method and system based on a Beidou inspection robot dog, and relates to the technical field of water and rain condition monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment point cloud data and the positioning data of the inspection robot dog; generating a three-dimensional terrain model according to the environment point cloud data; constructing a three-dimensional topology constraint model based on the three-dimensional terrain model, and performing anomaly correction in combination with the three-dimensional topology constraint model and the positioning data to obtain a corrected three-dimensional terrain model; establishing a motion feasibility matrix according to the corrected three-dimensional terrain model, and performing path planning on the inspection robot dog based on the motion feasibility matrix; acquiring historical water and rain monitoring data, and acquiring real-time water and rain monitoring data of a target area in real time by using an inspection robot dog; a dynamic risk evaluation model is constructed by combining real-time water and rain monitoring data and historical water and rain monitoring data, and a regional dynamic risk early warning region is generated based on the dynamic risk evaluation model and a three-dimensional terrain model. According to the invention, the response efficiency of water and rain condition emergency monitoring can be effectively improved.
source_title: Water and rain condition emergency monitoring method and system based on Beidou inspection robot dog

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot with flexible joints. The robot is characterized by comprising a rack and four mechanical legs, wherein the mechanical legs are connected to the two sides of the rack through outward swaying joints; an internal knee and elbow type symmetric structure is adopted for the four mechanical legs; each mechanical leg sequentially consists of an outward swaying joint, a hip joint frame, a hip joint, a thigh, an knee joint, a calf and a foot; each of the hip joints and the knee joints comprises a flexible joint main body which is of the same structure and has driving flexibility; the hip joints and the knee joints are driven by hip joint motors and knee joint motors respectively; the hip joint frames are L-shaped.
source_title: Quadruped robot with flexible joints

abstract: A four-section type omnibearing crawling and rolling quadruped robot comprises a trunk, four legs with same structures and an electric control part; the trunk is a rectangular box body at the center of a body; fixing holes are formed in the two sides of the trunk and used for connecting the trunk with the legs; the legs are divided into thighs and shanks; the thighs are the first section of circular arc parts connected with the trunk; steering engines are mounted at the two ends of the thighs and are used as joints connected with the trunk and the shanks; the shanks are parts having circular external edges and connected with the thighs; the thicknesses of the shanks are divided into three sections; the corresponding circular arc angles of foot ends, namely the thinnest sections of the shanks, are 30 degrees; the thicknesses of the thickest sections of the shanks are minimum thicknesses limited by mounting the steering engines; the corresponding circular arc angles of the thickest sections of the shanks are 20 degrees; and the middle sections of the shanks are inclined plane transitional sections. It is guaranteed that the opening and closing movements of the thighs cannot interferewith the legs on the same sides when the robot is closed into a circular structure; the steering engines drive the thighs and the shanks to deflect; the robot can be deformed in a cylindrical state;and the electric control part comprises a single chip microcomputer, steering engines and assorted driving plates and a six-axis sensor.
source_title: Four-section type omnibearing crawling and rolling quadruped robot

abstract: A hexapod robot device includes a main body and six legs coupled thereto. Each leg has a first connecting rod pivotally connected with the main body, a first driver electrically pivotally connected between the main body and the first connecting rod, with the first driver controllably driving the first connecting rod to move forward and backward along a longitudinal direction, a second connecting rod pivotally connected with the first connecting rod, and a second driver pivotally connected between the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod, with the second driver controllably driving the second connecting rod to move upward and downward along a vertical direction. The second connecting rod further has an end to engage with the ground.
source_title: Hexapod robot device

abstract: The invention relates to the related technical field of quadruped robots, in particular to a joint motor vibration reduction method used during jumping of a quadruped robot. Comprising the steps of robot jumping target setting, jumping action planning and trajectory design, control algorithm design and optimization, sensor system design and implementation, joint motor control and execution, shock absorption algorithm design and optimization and system integration and verification. According to the joint motor vibration reduction method used during jumping of the quadruped robot, when the quadruped robot executes jumping actions, in order to ensure the stability, accuracy and safety of the actions, a series of complex and key steps need to be carried out, firstly, setting of a jumping target is the starting point of the whole process, and the steps include determining the jumping height, the horizontal distance and the posture; by setting a reasonable jumping target, the robot can determine the direction and range of the action, and a basis is provided for subsequent action planning and control in a jumping target setting stage.
source_title: Joint motor vibration reduction method used during jumping of quadruped robot

abstract: The invention provides a wheel-leg hybrid hexapod robot. The robot comprises a vehicle frame, a brake system and six wheel sets; the brake system comprises a motor, a brake movement mechanism and a brake pump; the brake movement mechanism comprises a fixed frame and a transmission mechanism; the transmission mechanism comprises a screw rod transmission mechanism and a transmission guide mechanism;each wheel set comprises a wheel train, a wheel train steering system, a gait motion system and an H rod system; each wheel train steering system comprises a servo motor, a fixing seat, a fastening plate, a first short shaft, a coupler, a second short shaft, an upper bow plate, a lower bow plate and a bearing seat; each gait motion system comprises a gait adjusting structure and a buffering structure; each gait adjusting structure comprises a push rod motor, a rotating connecting plate, an upper rotating plate, a lower rotating plate, a push rod support, a rotating shaft, a bearing seat and afixing plate; and each buffering structure comprises a supporting frame, a damping fork, an upper connector, a lower connector, a buffering connector, an upper connecting rod, an H connecting rod, adamper and a limiting strip. According to the invention, the robot can be used for highly difficult operation such as investigation and rescue.
source_title: Wheel-leg hybrid hexapod robot

abstract: The invention discloses a variable-stiffness robot joint based on a magneto-rheological technology, and belongs to the technical field of variable-stiffness quadruped robots. The variable-stiffness robot joint comprises a flange, a coil baffle, an aluminum disc, a transmission shaft and an elastic unit. The aluminum disc is fixed to the outer side of the thigh of the quadruped robot, the flange is arranged at the other end of the aluminum disc, the flange is fixedly connected with the coil baffle, and the elastic unit is arranged between the aluminum disc and the flange; the transmission shaft is connected with the shank of the quadruped robot through a first common flat key. By the adoption of the structure, the magnetorheological fluid and the variable stiffness unit are subjected to integrated innovative design, and gravitational potential energy generated in the process that the quadruped robot jumps up and falls to the ground can be stored in the elastic unit and released when needed; the effect of buffering and vibration reduction can be achieved while it is guaranteed that the quadruped robot achieves outbreak jumping under the assistance of the variable-rigidity joints.
source_title: Variable stiffness robot joint based on magneto-rheological technology

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a bidirectional clutch wheel-leg switching structure and a leg structure of a quadruped robot, the bidirectional clutch wheel-leg switching structure is located on a thigh joint driving unit and comprises a machine shell, a bidirectional electromagnetic clutch mechanism, a hollow motor and a speed reducer, the hollow motor is arranged in the machine shell, and the speed reducer is arranged in the hollow motor. One part of the bidirectional electromagnetic clutch mechanism is arranged in the shell, the other part of the bidirectional electromagnetic clutch mechanism is arranged outside the machine shell, the output end, outside the machine shell, of the bidirectional electromagnetic clutch mechanism is connected with a hub input shaft of the hub, and the output end, in the shell, of the bidirectional electromagnetic clutch mechanism is connected with the input end of the speed reducer. An output shaft of the speed reducer is connected with a thigh joint, and switching motion between the wheel legs is achieved through a two-way electromagnetic clutch mechanism. According to the bidirectional clutch wheel-leg switching structure of the quadruped robot, the output direction of the rotating shaft of the motor can be automatically switched under the condition that all the components keep rotating, and the speed and continuity during wheel-leg switching are guaranteed.
source_title: Bidirectional clutch wheel-leg switching structure and leg structure of quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a four-footed inspection robot for a biosafety laboratory. The four-footed inspection robot comprises a laser radar module, an inertia measurement module, a map construction module, a pose measurement module, a high-precision positioning module, a path planning module, a real-time obstacle avoidance module, a mechanical arm module and an instrument digital recognition module. The pose measurement module is respectively connected with the laser radar module and the inertial measurement module; the path planning module is respectively connected with the map building module and the high-precision positioning module; the real-time obstacle avoidance module is connected with the laser radar module and the path planning module. The mechanical arm module is connected with the high-precision positioning module; and the instrument digital identification module is connected with the high-precision positioning module.
source_title: Four-footed inspection robot for biosafety laboratory

abstract: The invention relates to a quick dismounting mechanism for a driving circuit of a quadruped robot and a quick dismounting method for the driving circuit, the dismounting mechanism comprises a trunk and a driving circuit device, the driving circuit device is located in the trunk, the trunk is provided with a battery bin and a detachable movable frame, the driving circuit device is detachably installed on the surface of the movable frame, and the driving circuit device is located in the battery bin. The trunk is provided with a movable opening, and the movable frame can enter the trunk from the movable opening. The circuit board is installed on the movable frame, the mode that the circuit board is pulled out of the movable frame is used for replacing original robot shell disassembly and assembly, the time needed for replacing circuit device disassembly and assembly is greatly shortened, the replacement space of the circuit device is moved to the outer portion of the robot trunk, the operation space is wider relative to the interior of the trunk, and circuit device replacement is more convenient.
