source_title: Quadruped robot driving circuit quick release mechanism and driving circuit quick release method

abstract: The invention provides a posture detection system, a posture detection method, a robot dog, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of robots. The attitude detection system is used for a double-connecting-rod structure, and comprises a laser transmitter arranged in a lower connecting rod of the double-connecting-rod structure; the image sensor is arranged on the inner wall of the upper connecting rod of the double-connecting-rod structure and is used for receiving the laser beam emitted by the laser emitter; wherein an included angle between the lower connecting rod and the upper connecting rod corresponds to a pixel point of the laser beam on the image sensor. According to the invention, the precision of motion posture recognition is improved.
source_title: Posture detection system and method, robot dog, storage medium and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention discloses a special wheel-foot integrated hexapod robot based on OS wheels. The robot is composed of a robot body, a visual system, a positioning module, a control module, a comprehensive detection module, a power module and a storage module. The adopted OS type rotating wheel can greatly improve the obstacle crossing capacity of the robot, the robot body is divided into three sections, each of the three sections is connected to other sections through a spherical hinge, and the hinges are driven by three two-degree-of-freedom motors. The robot is more flexible due to the vehiclebody segmentation design and can be applied to various complex scenes. In addition, different sensors are arranged, so that the work of alarming, license plate recognition and the like can be effectively carried out. The robot comprehensively considers the advantages and disadvantages of a wheel type robot and a foot-shaped robot, has the capability of the foot-shaped robot to pass through different terrains, has a high moving speed, and has the advantages of being high in environmental adaptability, high in obstacle passing efficiency, high in land leveling speed, diverse in function, easy todisassemble and replace, low in maintenance cost, capable of being operated manually and the like.
source_title: Special wheel-foot integrated hexapod robot based on OS wheels

abstract: The quadruped robot comprises a robot body and four leg assemblies, each leg assembly has three degrees of freedom and comprises a thigh, a shank, a first motor, a second motor and a third motor, and the first motor is arranged on the robot body; the axis of the second motor is perpendicular to the axis direction of the first motor, the second motor is connected with an output shaft of the first motor through a first connecting structure, and the output shaft of the second motor is connected with the third motor through a second connecting structure; the axis directions of the third motor and the second motor are parallel; one end of the thigh is respectively connected with the second connecting structure and the third motor; and one end of the shank is connected with the output end of the third motor through a transmission structure, and is also connected with the other end of the thigh. The device is simple in structure, low in manufacturing cost and easy to implement.
source_title: Quadruped robot for heavy-load inspection

abstract: The invention discloses an unstructured environment quadruped robot stereoscopic vision positioning mapping method. The method comprises the following steps: mutually calibrating azimuth parameters in a camera and an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit); using IMU information between two frames of a binocular camera to predict the position of a pixel point of a previous frame in a current frame, using a minimum luminosity error to obtain pixel tracking information between the two frames, and extracting a successfully tracked feature combination; oRB local image feature description operators of left and right images of the current key frame in the key frame queue are calculated; after feature extraction of the current key frame is completed, binocular stereo image pair matching is carried out, pixels obtained by minimizing the luminosity error and pixel positions obtained by feature extraction are fused, redundant map feature points of the current key frame are screened, and new map feature points are created according to a binocular matching result; and optimizing and reducing the motion drift of the robot in the period by utilizing a pose map, and carrying out loopback detection. Visual pose state estimation in the unstructured environment is autonomously carried out, and the robot can conveniently complete navigation positioning in the outdoor unstructured environment.
source_title: Stereoscopic vision positioning mapping method for quadruped robot in unstructured environment

abstract: The present invention relates to a visual impairment experiential learning system using a robot dog (10). For a condition of a visually impaired person, a participant (30) wears an eye patch (blindfold) (31) and a body measuring device, a role of a blind assistance dog is replaced by a robot dog (10), and a role of a harness is replaced by guide equipment (32). In addition, a road environment experienced by the visually impaired from outdoors to a destination is replaced by a driving road for the visually impaired (flatland (21), uneven road (25), curved road (23), up and down stairs (24), and traffic light crosswalk (22)). When experiencing visual impairment using a participant self-measuring device (40), body data (blood pressure, pulse rate, stress index) of the participant (30) is measured, and based on a psychological state and body reaction at the time of the experience, the participant can understand a state of the body of a visually impaired person through the body data (blood pressure, pulse rate, stress index). By realizing the same environment experienced by the visually impaired until arriving at the destination, the visually impaired participant (30) can directly experience difficulties and pains experienced by the visually impaired.
source_title: Visual impairment experience learning system using robot dogs

abstract: The invention discloses a novel leg structure for a multi-legged robot. The novel leg structure comprises a shank assembly and a thigh assembly. The shank assembly comprises a foot end, a foot end connecting piece, a first guide rail plate, a second guide rail plate, a first shank clamping plate, a second shank clamping plate, a sliding rod, a spring, a check block and a fixing plate. The thigh assembly comprises a first thigh clamping plate, a second thigh clamping plate, a transmission rod, a rotating rod, a steering engine, a steering engine frame, a first coupler, a second coupler, a firstbearing, a second bearing, a third bearing, a bearing seat, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear and a plurality of fixing rods. The novel leg structure can adapt to complex terrains, has obviousadvantages, such as hilly and mountainous forests, and is good in movement effect and high in efficiency, so that the robot has excellent movement ability.
source_title: Novel leg structure for multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention discloses a milling cutter-type big-gradient robot foot capable of actively changing soft terrains, relates to a robot foot, and solves the problem that according to a big-gradient robotfoot, the condition that a robot can climb up a slope with a big gradient is difficult to guarantee. A leg connecting flange and an ankle joint are assembled together and form a revolute pair; the lower end of a joint support is fixedly connected with the upper end of a milling cutter-type sole through a spring damping device; the lower part of a bearing mounting flange is embedded in the lower part of the milling cutter-type sole through a large bearing which is mounted in a sleeving manner; a small bearing is arranged in the upper part of the bearing mounting flange; a safety clutch and a rotating spindle are sequentially arranged in the center of the milling cutter-type sole from top to bottom; the upper part of the rotating spindle is mounted on the bearing mounting flange through thesmall bearing; the lower end of the rotating spindle is fixedly connected with the milling cutter-type sole; the upper end of the rotating spindle and the lower end of the safety clutch are fixedly connected through the connecting flange; and an output shaft of a speed reducer is mounted in the center hole of the safety clutch in a cooperative manner. The milling cutter-type big-gradient robot foot disclosed by the invention is used for a quadruped robot.
source_title: Milling cutter-type big-gradient robot foot capable of actively changing soft terrains

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a multi-mode wheel-leg separation type quadruped robot control system. The control system comprises a terrain recognition module, a mode conversion module, a mode conversion control module, a remote controller or a man-machine interaction system and an upboard controller. The control system relates to wheel mode, foot mode and foot-wheel mode switching control, and effectively solves the problem of how to perform coordinated control when a multi-mode robot faces a multi-scene task demand. According to the system, trajectory tracking control in a wheel mode, motion control in a foot mode and a conversion system between the trajectory tracking control and the motion control are combined, the functions of the multi-mode robot can be efficiently played, and the moving efficiency of the robot is improved.
source_title: Multi-mode wheel-leg separation type quadruped robot control system

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot motion control, and particularly relates to a quadruped robot motion control method and system based on voice interaction, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a voice signal; identifying and analyzing the acquired voice signal to obtain a voice control signal; based on the obtained voice control signal, a voice control module in the quadruped robot is started, the obtained voice control signal is processed, and a control instruction is obtained; according to the obtained control instruction, voice control over the quadruped robot is achieved.
source_title: Quadruped robot motion control method and system based on voice interaction

abstract: The invention discloses a flexible spine quadruped bionic robot. The flexible spine quadruped bionic robot comprises a front body, a waist mechanism, a rear body, a leg mechanism and a side swing assembly. According to the flexible spine quadruped bionic robot, a parallel mechanism with the three degrees of freedom is adopted to connect the front body and the rear body, thus the whole robot is provided with a flexible spine, and the effects of energy storage, coordination and vibration reduction can be achieved in the traveling process; four legs of the whole bionic robot adopts configurationof front knuckle and rear keen joints, through the configuration mode, energy consumption can be greatly reduced, certain terrain adaptability is achieved, each leg of the robot has the three degreesof freedom, namely the two rotating degrees of freedom in the advancing direction and one rotating degree of freedom in the side swing direction. The flexible spine quadruped bionic robot can move ona complex pavement and is the novel quadruped bionic robot.
source_title: Flexible spine quadruped bionic robot

abstract: The invention provides a multi-posture pipeline inspection quadruped robot based on air cylinders and pneumatic muscles, the inspection quadruped robot can realize overturning and multi-form movement in a pipeline, has the characteristics of multiple degrees of freedom and rigid-flexible combination, and comprises a front machine body and a rear machine body, inspection equipment is mounted on the front machine body, and the rear machine body is mounted on the rear machine body. The front machine body and the rear machine body are both provided with legs, the legs are driven by air cylinders and pneumatic muscles, the front machine body and/or the rear machine body are/is provided with an overturning supporting mechanism, and the front machine body and/or the rear machine body are/is provided with a driving module used for driving the legs to move and driving the overturning supporting mechanism to move. The front machine body and the rear machine body are connected through a flexible waist part, and the leg parts are provided with telescopic foot ends.
source_title: Multi-posture pipeline inspection quadruped robot based on air cylinders and pneumatic muscles

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and particularly discloses a hexapod robot vehicle frame system. For the problem that certain deficiencies exist in existing rectangular vehiclebodies, round vehicle bodies, ring-beam-shaped vehicle bodies and vehicle bodies combining rectangular and oval vehicle bodies, the following scheme is provided that the hexapod robot vehicle frame system comprises a plurality of fixed trusses and a cab frame; the multiple trusses form a rectangular vehicle body, and each fixed truss comprises two main rods, wherein inclined rods and vertical rodswhich are distributed at equal intervals are fixedly installed between the main rods; support parts are fixedly installed on the opposite side of the rectangular vehicle body, and reinforcing steel channels are fixedly installed on the sides, opposite to the rectangular vehicle body, of the support parts; the reinforcing steel channels and the support parts form an engine installation base; evenly distributed valve blocks and a filter fixing plate are fixedly installed on the rectangular vehicle body; and a control room is arranged in the cab frame. Design, manufacture and installation of thetrusses are all simple and convenient, and machining and manufacture cost can be lowered.
source_title: Hexapod robot vehicle frame system

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot obstacle avoidance control method and system based on path planning, and relates to the technical field of quadruped robot obstacle avoidance control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment point cloud data, image data and quadruped robot motion speed data, and carrying out the terrain semantic segmentation and semantic pixel back projection of the image data, thereby obtaining a quadruped robot obstacle avoidance result; generating semantic point cloud data, combining the semantic point cloud data with the environment point cloud data subjected to motion compensation, and constructing a semantic annotation grid map; performing global path search on the semantic annotation grid map to generate a global smooth path; when the quadruped robot advances along the global smooth path, path nodes on the global smooth path are extracted at a fixed step pitch, the terrain category and the grid occupation state of each path node are judged according to the semantic annotation grid map, and a local reference path is generated; and executing a multi-stage obstacle avoidance strategy on the local reference path, and generating a foot end track sequence.
source_title: Quadruped robot obstacle avoidance control method and system based on path planning

abstract: The invention provides a gait switching method and device for a quadruped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target position of each supporting leg of the quadruped robot in a first gait; the target position is the end position of each supporting leg after the quadruped robot walks for at least one motion period; controlling the quadruped robot to be switched from the first gait to the second gait based on the gait switching time sequence and the target position of each supporting leg; the gait switching time sequence is used for indicating the walking sequence and the beat motion amount of each supporting leg when the quadruped robot is switched from the first gait to the second gait. According to the gait switching method and device of the quadruped robot, when the target position of each supporting leg of the quadruped robot at the first gait is obtained, the walking sequence and the beat motion amount of each supporting leg are indicated based on the gait switching time sequence, and the quadruped robot is controlled to be directly switched from the first gait to the second gait; the continuity and rapidity of the switching process of the first gait and the second gait of the quadruped robot can be achieved.
source_title: Gait switching method and device of quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a four-legged bionic robot based on a six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism. The four-legged bionic robot comprises a trunk and four lower limbs, the four lower limbs are uniformly and symmetrically distributed at four corners of the lower part of the trunk, and the structures of the four lower limbs are identical. The trunk comprises the six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism and four driving units. The two ends of the six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism are separately provided with two driving units. The six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism comprises a moving platform and a static platform which are arranged in parallel with each other, six rod piece motors are fixedly arranged on the moving platform, and six rod pieces are connected between the rodpiece motors and the static platform. Each lower limb comprises a thigh, a shank and a foot. The upper ends of the thighs are fixedly connected with the driving units, the lower ends of the thighs arerotatably connected with the upper ends of the shanks, and the lower ends of the shanks are connected with the feet. The trunk enlarges the motion space of the robot, reduces the complexity of a waist mechanism of the robot, improves the motion precision of a waist of the four-legged robot, improves the stability and the movement performance of the legged robot, and expands the application fieldof the legged robot.
source_title: Four-legged bionic robot based on six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses a hexapod robot. The robot comprises a head part, a body, a driving device, a transmission system and six mechanical legs. The hexapod robot is characterized in that the six mechanical legs are reversely and symmetrically mounted on both sides of the long edge of the body, and adopt the completely same structures; the driving device and the transmission system are arrayed at the inner part of the body; the driving device performs driving through a servo motor, and the transmission system performs transmission through sprocket chains; three output rods are also arranged at the inner part of the body, and the two mechanical legs are reversely and symmetrically mounted on both sides of each output rod; the six mechanical legs are divided into three groups, and the three groups of output rods are connected in a transmission manner by adopting the sprocket chains; the servo motor of the driving device designed at the inner part of the body simultaneously drives the six mechanical legs to move.
source_title: Hexapod robot

abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional on-site material evidence investigation and evidence obtaining system based on an intelligent robot dog, and belongs to the technical field of criminal investigation. According to the system, a robot dog is driven by a communication device and a positioner to reach a trace detection site, and collected trace detection image data are transmitted to a main control device; attitude precision adjustment is carried out through a joint encoder arranged on the angle driving framework in combination with the collected trace detection image data; calculating the actual distance between the microscope and the target trace through a trace detection distance model; based on the actual distance, the focusing driving framework is controlled to move in combination with the corresponding initial focusing parameters; and performing real-time definition evaluation on the acquired trace detection image through a definition evaluation framework, recording an optimal focusing position and related trace detection image data after the evaluation is passed, and updating a database. The multi-scene application of trace detection is realized, the problem of blurring of the trace detection image caused by environmental interference or sample movement is solved, and the focusing quality and the shooting success rate of trace detection shooting are effectively improved.
source_title: Multifunctional on-site material evidence investigation and evidence obtaining system based on intelligent robot dog

abstract: The invention provides a dry adhesion and claw combined quadruped multiphibious robot and a bionic motion method and belongs to the field of robots. A body main body of the dry adhesion and claw combined quadruped multiphibious robot comprises a front foot supporting frame (3), N series-connected body Z-axis steering engines and a rear foot supporting frame (18); a head neck structure comprises ahead Y-axis steering engine (2) and a camera (1); a tail structure comprises a tail X-axis steering engine (26), a tail X-axis steering engine U-shaped connecting piece (27), M series-connected tail Z-axis steering engine and a tail fin (31); and each foot structure consists of a foot Y-axis steering engine, a supporting foot, a paddle, a claw and a dry adhesion material. The dry adhesion and clawcombined quadruped multiphibious robot can satisfy self-adaptive requirements of a non-structural topographic water surface-land surface under a natural environment; and meanwhile, the dry adhesion and claw combined quadruped multiphibious robot can adopt dry adhesion to perform large slope wall surface climbing on a smooth surface and can also adopt the claw to perform large slope wall surface climbing on a rough surface; and the dry adhesion and claw combined quadruped multiphibious robot can be used as a dry adhesion and claw four-wheel-foot-paddle-driven multiphibious robot on an all terrain multiphibious cross-country mobile platform under the natural environment.
source_title: Dry adhesion and claw combined quadruped multiphibious robot and bionic motion method

abstract: The invention provides a quadruped robot which comprises a robot body, a front part and a rear part of the robot body are hinged through a steering hinge, horizontal plane connection angle rotation is conducted, a data selling mechanism is arranged on the front side of the robot body, and a data collecting mechanism is hinged to the robot body to perform horizontal and vertical plane angle rotation. The robot is characterized in that movement mechanisms which are switched between a wheel type state and a bionic foot type state by changing the connecting angles of connecting rods and arc-shaped pieces are distributed at the four corners of the robot body, and each movement mechanism comprises an arc-shaped assembly which drives foot wheels through two sets of rotating shafts and a motor at the same time; the differential motion between the two sets of motors drives the arc-shaped assemblies of the foot wheels to move and deform, stepless adjustment from a wheel type structure to a foot type structure is achieved, and the quadruped robot is suitable for various ground environments and has the rice management applicability and good development prospects.
source_title: Quadruped robot for acquiring spatial three-dimensional data

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of amphibious robots, and particularly relates to a land-air dual-purpose bionic hexapod robot which can be used in complex terrains. The land-air dual-purpose bionic hexapod robot is composed of a control assembly, six sets of walking assemblies and six sets of flight assemblies. The control assembly comprises a single chip microcontroller, an electronic governor, a main support plate, a flight control panel, a motor driver and a steering engine control panel, wherein the flight control panel, the motor driver and the steering engine control panelare fixed to the main support plate separately. Each set of walking assemblies comprises a steering engine III connected to the main support plate, a steering engine II connected to the steering engine III through a cross plate and mechanical legs connected to the steering engine II through a U-shaped plate. Each set of flight assemblies comprises a motor connected to an electronic governor and apropeller winding and unwinding mechanism. According to the land-air dual-purpose bionic hexapod robot, through the combination of a foot type robot and a multi-shaft unmanned aerial vehicle, the shortcomings of the foot type robot and the multi-shaft unmanned aerial vehicle are overcome greatly, a motor and the propellers can enable the robot to climb over obstacles to realize short-distance flight, and a fast speed can also be achieved at the same time.
source_title: Land-air dual-purpose bionic hexapod robot

abstract: A quadruped robot device based on competition teaching comprises a front robot trunk and a rear robot trunk, wherein the front robot trunk and the rear robot trunk are connected through a robot steering mechanism; robot leg mechanisms with front and rear phase angle difference of 180 degrees are connected to the front robot trunk and the rear robot trunk; the robot leg mechanisms are connected with robot driving mechanisms; power sources, electric control systems and vision navigation systems are installed on the robot trunks, and the power sources drive the robot driving mechanisms to rotateso as to transmit power to the robot leg mechanisms; the electric control systems are control systems for controlling motors and the robot driving mechanisms 3; and the vision navigation systems monitor the front obstacle condition in real time, plan a running route, and provide environment perception and target guidance for the robot. The quadruped robot device has the advantages of higher control and motion stability, flexible motion, capability of being suitable for various scenes for walking and obstacle crossing, simple structure, low cost and the like.
source_title: Quadruped robot device based on competition teaching

abstract: The invention relates to a variable-structure quadruped and hexapod robot based on steering engines and an advancing method thereof, belongs to the technical field of robots, and solves the problems in the prior art. The leg comprises a main body structure, a front foot, a rear foot and a middle foot, the two front feet, the two rear feet and the two middle feet are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the main body structure; the middle foot is rotationally connected with the main body structure, and a mechanical clamping jaw capable of clamping articles is mounted on the middle foot; the middle foot can serve as a walking foot or a mechanical arm. According to the robot, switching between four-foot walking and six-foot walking of the robot is achieved, switching between the middle foot serving as the walking foot and the mechanical arm function is achieved, the robot has multiple structural forms, and the walking mode switching and object clamping and transporting functions are achieved.
source_title: Steering engine-based variable-structure quadruped and hexapod robot and advancing method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot, belongs to the field of quadruped robots, solves the problems that the assembly of the quadruped robot is complicated and the efficiency is low, and adopts the technical scheme that the quadruped robot mainly comprises a trunk, four leg modules and a control box for controlling the operation of the quadruped robot, the leg module comprises a first motor, a second motor, a third motor, a thigh mechanism, a shank mechanism and a foot end piece, the first motor is installed on the trunk, an adapter of the first motor is connected with a connecting assembly, the second motor is sleeved with the connecting assembly of the first motor, and the adapter and the third motor are sleeved with the connecting assembly of the second motor; the third motor is fixedly connected with the thigh mechanism through a connecting assembly, an adapter of the third motor is connected with the shank mechanism through a connecting rod, the control box is installed in the trunk, and the first motor, the second motor and the third motor are all electrically connected with the control box. The method is mainly used for improving the assembly efficiency and the maintenance efficiency of the quadruped robot.
source_title: Quadruped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a bionic quadruped robot foot. The bionic quadruped robot foot comprises a claw system; the claw system comprises a bionic claw tip, a connecting rod, a basic framework, a bionic foot pad, a telescopic spring, a long rod and a fixing pin; the basic framework comprises a fixed block and a plurality of quadrilateral plates; the bionic foot pad is positioned below the basic framework; the number of the connecting rods is not less than 3 and is one less than that of the quadrilateral plates; the connecting rods are respectively inserted into the intervals between the quadrilateral plates and are in one-to-one correspondence with the intervals between the quadrilateral plates; the bionic claw tip comprises a rod I, a rod II and a rod III which are connected in sequence, one end, not connected with the rod II, of the rod I is a tip end, and the tip end faces downwards; when the bionic foot pad does not make contact with the ground, the bottom of the bionic foot pad is located below the tip end of the rod I; when the bionic foot pad is in contact with the ground, the tip end of the rod I is also in contact with the ground and keeps still. The feet of the bionic quadruped robot can obtain good road holding force and stability on frozen soil and ice surfaces, and the bionic quadruped robot runs stably; the structure is simple, and operation is convenient.
source_title: Foot of bionic quadruped robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent ridable machine blind guiding device and method, and relates to the technical field of robots and artificial intelligence. Comprising the steps that a user takes a bearing module, necessary information is transmitted to a control module through a data acquisition module, the control module generates a corresponding control instruction through an artificial intelligence algorithm, and all the modules execute the corresponding instruction through a wireless communication module to control running of the robot dog; the monitoring and early warning module can carry out early warning in advance through remote monitoring, the battery module detects the electric quantity of the battery and the charging module in the driving process, and adjustment is flexible; therefore, through high-precision perception, intelligent authentication, dynamic stable control, wireless charging and multi-mode interaction, the defects of a traditional blind guiding tool in the aspects of navigation precision, safety, endurance, interactive experience and the like are overcome, and the intelligence, stability and safety of visual impaired people going out are greatly improved.
source_title: Intelligent ridable machine blind guiding device and method

abstract: The invention relates to a single leg structure of an electric quadruped robot. The single leg structure comprises a hip joint, a knee joint, a thigh connecting rod, a shank connecting rod and a foot,the hip joint comprises a first hip joint body and a second hip joint body, the second hip joint body is connected with the power output end of the first hip joint body, the knee joint is connected with the power output end of the first hip joint body through the thigh connecting rod, the knee joint is in rigid connection with the second hip joint body, the power output end of the second hip joint body is connected with power input end of the knee joint through the transmission mechanism, the shank is fixedly connected to the power output end of the knee joint, and the foot is connected to the shank. According to the structure, the low quality and low rotating inertia of the thigh and the shank is guaranteed, the good motion performance is achieved, the structure is simple and compact, itis guaranteed that the knee joint and the hip joint of the single leg have the good reverse drive characteristic, and the single leg structure can be used for assembling the electric quadruped robotwhich is capable of bouncing and high in load deadweight ratio.
source_title: Single leg structure of electric quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic quadruped robot, comprising a frame, a control system, a power supply system, an attitude sensor, an electromagnetic valve, a driving mechanism, a foot mechanism and a leg mechanism, wherein the leg mechanism comprises a thigh part and a shank part, wherein the thigh part comprises a vertical supporting sliding rail, a thigh telescopic air cylinder, a transversesliding bearing box and a vertical sliding bearing box, and the vertical supporting sliding rail moves up and down in the vertical sliding bearing box; the shank part comprises a shank telescopic sliding rail and a shank telescopic air cylinder, and the shank telescopic sliding rail moves up and down on the vertical supporting sliding rail; the frame comprises a side frame and a plurality of sliding rails; the transverse sliding bearing boxes of the thigh parts are respectively sleeved on the respective sliding rails; the driving mechanism drives a leg mechanism of the robot to move back andforth along the sliding rail; and the attitude sensor provides an attitude signal for the control system, and the output end of the control system provides a control signal for the driving motor and the electromagnetic valve. The pneumatic quadruped robot is extremely low in manufacturing cost and beneficial for researchers to research the influence of gravity center and inertia on the quadruped robot.
source_title: Pneumatic quadruped robot

abstract: The invention relates to the field of air-ground robots, in particular to an air-ground dual-purpose hexapod robot. The robot is characterized in that a quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is combined with a hexapod robot, and the robot specifically comprises a control cabin, a flying mechanism and a crawling mechanism. The control cabinet (1) and the flying mechanism (2) form the upper half part of the robot, and the crawling mechanism forms the lower half part of the robot. The unmanned aerial vehicle upper cover plate (13) and the vehicle arm (23) are located between the unmanned aerial vehicle upper cover plate (13) and the unmanned aerial vehicle lower cover plate (15) and connected through a folding mechanism A (21) and a folding mechanism B (22), and the motor pile (24) is located in the tail end of the vehicle arm (23) and internally provided with a rotor wing motor (26). And a crawling mechanism at the lower part of the robot realizes the movement of a foot structure through a hip joint steering engine (31), a knee joint steering engine (32) and an ankle joint steering engine (36). The problem that an existing robot is poor in land obstacle crossing ability is solved, and the robot can adapt to more complex geographical environments. And investigation and exploration tasks can be carried out in complex environments such as low-lying places and caves.
source_title: Air-ground dual-purpose hexapod robot

abstract: The invention discloses a modularized self-balancing double-wheel quadruped robot comprising a bicycle body. A battery and a control system are installed on the bicycle body. The modularized self-balancing double-wheel quadruped robot is characterized in that a self-balancing system and a quadruped system are further arranged on the bicycle body, and the self-balancing system comprises a balancing assembly and a steering assembly; the balancing assembly is installed at the front end of a frame head tube and used for controlling balance of a bicycle; the steering assembly is fixed to the balancing assembly and connected with a handle through gears and a belt, and the steering assembly controls steering of the bicycle by controlling rotation of the handle; and the quadruped system comprises four quadruped assemblies which are installed on the two sides of a front wheel and the two sides of a rear wheel correspondingly and each have three freedom degrees, and the quadruped systems are used for assisting the bicycle in walking. The balance state of the bicycle body and the motion state of each foot are detected through attitude sensors, double-wheel running and quadruped walking can be achieved, and a good movable carrier is provided for an artificial intelligence algorithm.
source_title: Modularized self-balancing double-wheel quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a carbon fiber M-type parallel hexapod robot. The robot comprises at least two pairs of supporting legs. Each pair of supporting legs form an M-shaped leg; the supporting legs comprise thighs, shanks, equivalent linear driving devices I, equivalent linear driving devices II and equivalent linear driving devices III; the inner ends of the thighs can be rotatably mounted on the machine body around a vertical axis and a horizontal axis, and the outer ends are rotatably connected with the top ends of the shanks; the bottom ends of the shanks are supported on the ground; the two ends of the equivalent linear driving device I are rotationally mounted between the machine body and the outer ends of the thighs; the two ends of the equivalent linear driving device II are rotationally mounted between the inner ends of the thighs and the bottom ends of the shanks; the two ends of the third equivalent linear driving device are rotationally installed between the machine body and the bottom ends of the shanks. The robot can better meet the multi-arm supporting task requirement under the complex environment.
source_title: Carbon fiber M-type parallel hexapod robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot dog control method, and aims to provide a control method for remote cooperative control of a robot dog, a control module and an imaging helmet, and the main points of the technical scheme are that the method comprises the following steps: S1, an information collection stage: collecting video data of a surrounding environment in real time through a camera arranged on the robot dog; s2, a video data transmitting and receiving stage: transmitting the video data to an imaging helmet through a robot dog communication unit, and imaging the video data to a user visual interface at the same time; s3, in the video picture adjusting stage of the user, a control chip in the robot dog can sense rotation of the head of the user, and the robot dog can synchronize the rotation angle of the head of the human body in real time; s4, in an action data acquisition stage, acquiring a human body action instruction through a control module, and transmitting the human body action instruction to the robot dog, so that the robot dog synchronously completes the human body action instruction; and S5, a data information conversion stage: converting the acquired action data, and transmitting the converted action data to a control chip of the robot dog through a communication unit arranged in the robot dog.
source_title: Robot dog, control module and control method for remote cooperative control of imaging helmet

abstract: The invention discloses a robot dog for cable channel inspection. The robot dog comprises a power source and two oppositely-installed power assemblies, a rotating part is fixed to one side of each power assembly, a main arm is fixed to the surface of each rotating part, a supporting arm is movably connected to the surface of each main arm through a pin shaft, and an upper connecting lug is movably connected to the surface of each supporting arm; the lower surface of the upper connecting lug is fixedly connected with a pressure adjusting assembly, the lower surface of the pressure adjusting assembly is fixedly connected with an air-tight sealing bin, the lower surface of the air-tight sealing bin is fixedly connected with an upper sealing disc, and a rubber air cushion is fixed to the inner wall of the upper sealing disc through an upper fixing piece. The inner wall of the lower sealing disc is fixed to the bottom of the rubber air cushion in a sealed mode through a lower fixed piece. An air pump is fixed to the surface of the upper connecting lug in a penetrating mode, one end of the air pump communicates with the inner wall of the air-tight sealing bin through a hose, and an electromagnetic control body is arranged on the inner supporting bone and the air-tight sealing bin in a jointly penetrating mode. The problem of insufficient instantaneous high-strength power output of the power assembly can be solved.
source_title: Robot dog for cable channel inspection

abstract: The invention discloses a frontier defense robot dog with an automatic obstacle avoidance function, and relates to the technical field of intelligent security equipment, the frontier defense robot dog with the automatic obstacle avoidance function comprises a control base internally provided with a storage battery, and the left side and the right side of the control base are fixedly connected with connecting frames; according to the robot dog disclosed by the invention, a three-degree-of-freedom kinematic chain is constructed through vertical lifting of an unfolding push rod, horizontal steering of a bevel gear set and leg swinging driven by double servo motors, so that the robot dog has a'lifting-rotating-stepping 'composite motion capability; compared with the limitation that a wheel type structure depends on friction force for driving, the four-foot mechanism makes point contact with the ground through the cushion blocks, the lever principle is used for achieving pedaling for power generation, the four-foot mechanism can stably advance on low-adhesion road surfaces such as muddy road surfaces and gravel road surfaces, the mechanical efficiency is remarkably improved, and the physical adaptability to complex terrains is remarkably improved.
source_title: Frontier defense robot dog with automatic obstacle avoidance function
